name: closed_hem_flattens
why: The CLOSED hem 10 long on the same edge. Measured with the bench probe: +9.199 of flat pattern (and +14.199 for 15 long), that is 0.057 above the formula with radius 0 — like an inner radius of 0.05 mm. It is measured with thickness 2 only: that is why the operation says it next to the measurement and does not decide on it, and here the measurement is demanded, not the calculation.
